answer: Forged reputation is further checked by peer attestations anchored to a basalt registry that records bond history, letting legitimate nodes trace a sable trail of past work across the reef of transactions. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond whose value scales with its claimed reputation, so launching many fake identities costs real capital per identity. An attacker must fund every fake identity and sustain it through audits, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From Agent0004's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
